purpose: Remove only the NVIDIA residual-matrix Sinkhorn operation; retain signed raw mixing, every other operator and initialization.
connection_backend: nvidia for mhc; ordinary gradient accumulation, no FP32 fusion buffers
initialization: All backbone AND connector tensors bitwise equal to mHC under seed42. Only the residual matrix mapping changes, so initial effective mixing is not equal.
optimizer: Native MuonAdamW/default LR and native batch-width scaling
dataset: FineWeb-Edu official sample-10BT revision87f09149; train000..012 heldout013
budget_status: Explicitly confirmed10B training tokens per model

validation.final_test: Final checkpoint and dev-selected checkpoint; test never used for selection

checkpoint.transfer: HTCondor exit85/spool every4h; final latest+best archive returned to a unique home path, budget<2GiB for this additional run.

gate: 9 GPU unit/integration checks plus a full D512 micro16 run:25 steps, exit85, new process to50. Gate uses the previously verified golden1B prefix and full305176-step LR schedule.
submission: One formal305176-step job is submitted held, then automatically released only after gate audit. Formal run starts from scratch, never resumes diagnostic weights.
packing: Unmodified native BOS best-fit loader; verify golden 1B prefix and dev/test SHA-256; cycle only train000..012 if needed and report source epochs
wandb_policy: Only formal training; all diagnostics/data preparation/evaluation write local JSON only
residual_mixing: unconstrained raw scaled projection plus existing identity bias; no exp/softmax/Sinkhorn/clipping
ablation_scope: No original-HC reproduction; pre/post sigmoid gates, RMSNorm and initialization remain mHC.
